messages:
maya: FYI — AcmeCorp flagged a month-close mismatch. Dashboard shows ~1,200,423 tokens for Mar; invoice charges 1,503,210. They want a line-item breakdown before the customer escalates to procurement. Invoice INV-2026-03-ACME-1187. Can billing + eng triage?

Tom_finance: Thanks. Can you confirm the billing period and plan tier? Also need the invoice PDF URL if available. We should check whether committed units or overages applied.

sasha_support: Customer says their org is on Pro Plus (500k committed). Billing period is 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-31. Invoice PDF: https://billing.redwood-internal/example/INV-2026-03-ACME-1187.pdf (customer provided).

billing_bot: Invoice INV-2026-03-ACME-1187 processed at 1765067000. Line items: "base_commit": 500000 tokens, "overage_generated": 1003210 tokens, "embeddings": 100000 tokens. Total tokens reported: 1,603,210. (system note)

maya: That system breakdown looks off vs what the dashboard shows. Dashboard (per-customer view) export attached: https://dash.redwood-internal/exports/acme/2026-03-usage.csv — totals there are 1,200,423 tokens (generated + embeddings combined).

eli_engineer: Quick hypothesis: we sometimes double-count test/org aliases (acme-test or acme-internal) if events were ingested with different org_ids and later merged; invoice pipeline sums by billing_account_id. Can someone run a per-org token sum for the billing_account_id and include source tags? Suggested query to run against internal warehouse:

```sql
SELECT billing_account_id, org_id, source, SUM(tokens) AS tokens
FROM usage_events
WHERE billing_account_id = 'acct_acme_01'
  AND event_ts >= '2026-03-01' AND event_ts < '2026-04-01'
GROUP BY billing_account_id, org_id, source
ORDER BY tokens DESC;
```

eli_engineer: Also check for events with source IN ('replay', 'test-run') — those should be excluded from billing if flagged.

Tom_finance: If billing_bot is showing 1,603,210 but customer sees 1,200,423, the delta ~402,787 tokens. Need to know whether the invoice included a one-time migration charge or refunds were misapplied. Who owns the pipeline that aggregates overage tokens?

maya: @eli_engineer can you run the query and attach raw rows? sasha, can you ask the customer if they have any internal test projects that might have been accidentally billed under the same account?

sasha_support: Reached out to customer — they confirmed two internal test projects were live for a day (acme-test-a, acme-experiments) and they thought tests were on a sandbox org. They sent a screenshot of org list.

eli_engineer: Ran the query — raw output (top rows):

```
billing_account_id | org_id          | source       | tokens
acct_acme_01       | org_acme_prod   | generation   | 1,100,123
acct_acme_01       | org_acme_prod   | embedding    |   100,300
acct_acme_01       | org_acme_test   | generation   |   200,000
acct_acme_01       | org_acme_expt   | replay       |   203,787
```

eli_engineer: Looks like test orgs contributed ~403,787 tokens (200k generation + 203,787 replay). The invoice pipeline currently sums by billing_account_id without excluding 'replay' source — replay should be filtered for accounts with sandbox flag. I see two issues: (1) replay events are billed, (2) test orgs live under same billing account.

Tom_finance: That matches the delta. Action: if replay events are not billable per policy, we should issue a credit for 203,787 tokens and roll back any accidental overage charge. Approving provisional credit pending accounting review.

raj_sales: I'll coordinate with Acme's procurement contact and give them ETA. Please confirm credit amount and timeline.

maya: Next steps: eli to file an ENG ticket to exclude 'replay' events or add sandbox flag handling in aggregation, billing to prepare provisional credit for 203,787 tokens (approx $X — finance will compute), sasha to confirm which org_ids to exclude and capture customer consent for credit.

eli_engineer: Filing ticket now: https://tracker.internal/ENG-5932 — description: "Billing aggregation: exclude replay sources and implement billing_account -> org alias mapping to prevent test org leakage." Will include SQL used and raw rows. ETA for fix: 7 business days.

billing_bot: Credit request created: CR-2026-03-ACME-42 (status: pending-accounting).

maya: Great. Please keep thread updated. If accounting approves immediate provisional credit we should notify Acme to prevent escalation. :thumbsup:

sasha_support: Noted — customer happy to accept provisional credit while engineering fixes aggregation. I'll update them after accounting confirmation. :white_check_mark:
